description: This file defines serializers and copiers for the Uri type in the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes methods for reading, writing, and copying Uri instances, and references external serialization helpers and wire protocol components.

classes.name: UriCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the Uri class, implementing IFieldCodec and IDerivedTypeCodec, providing methods for reading and writing Uri instances in a serialized form.

classes.name: UriCopier
classes.description: A shallow copier for Uri instances, marked with RegisterCopier attribute, used for copying Uri objects within the serialization system.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a Uri value from the buffer, handling references and creating Uri instances from string representation.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Uri value into the buffer, with optional reference tracking.

methods.name: WriteField (static)
methods.description: Serializes a Uri value into the buffer without type info, optimized for expected static type.
